summary: The SiteProfileClosures functionality manages site closures and the associated disciplines in a web application interface. It consists of multiple UI components for filtering, editing, and applying destinations related to site closures.
purpose: To facilitate the management of site closures by allowing users to add, edit, and delete closure records and manage associated destination data.

fields.name: ClosureID
fields.description: Unique identifier for a site closure record.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site associated with the closure.

fields.name: AppliedDestinations
fields.description: Serialized list of destinations applied to a closure.

workflows.name: Manage Site Closures
steps: User selects a site closure record from the grid.
User clicks 'Add' to insert a new closure or 'Edit' to modify an existing one.
User enters the necessary details and destinations.

business_rules: Site closures can only be edited if the screen is editable.
Destinations must be loaded and verified before being applied to a closure.
validations: Ensure closure ID and site ID are greater than 0 before processing updates.
Validate input fields before proceeding with data insertion or updating.
conditions: If the closure ID is nonexistent, disable the edit operations.
Show or hide destination controls based on user input and closure properties.
system_behavior: Automatically serialize and deserialize destination lists for storage and retrieval.
Redirect users to the current page URL after successful insert or update operations.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for maintaining user sessions and data persistence.
User interface controls and components such as GridView, ListBox, and DropDownList.
exceptions: Cancel operations when the user session is null or not valid.
Prevent actions if mandatory session parameters are missing.
